22/S0.subgoal: Summarize the different ways AR software can be categorized.

22/S1.subgoal: Describe rapid prototyping tools used for developing AR experiences.

22/S2.subgoal: Explain the concept and utility of using plugins to augment existing software tools.

22/S3.subgoal: Analyze the advantages and disadvantages of using plugin-based approaches in AR development.

22/S4.subgoal: Understand the necessity of using low-level software development tools for AR systems.

22/S5.subgoal: Describe how standalone authoring tools facilitate AR creation without requiring programming experience.

22/S6.subgoal: Summarize the four main categories of AR software based on the programming skill required.
